regression.def: fits a trend line over the comparable historical blocks and projects one step forward — not a flat average, it reflects whether the metric has been trending up or down.

range.def: ± 1 standard deviation of the same historical blocks: the floor is the low scenario, to review if it materializes; the ceiling is the high scenario, positive and worth sustaining. The more irregular the history, the further apart they are.

risk.def: facilities whose projected demand rate falls at least 1 point below their own average, or that project many cancellations with confirmed games below their average. Rising ones project confirmed games above their average without the rate dropping.

week.title: This week's calendar
week.subtitle: What should be scheduled each day based on the facility's last {months} months ({from} → {to}). It is a historical reference per slot: the database does not include games already published.
week.empty: This facility has no recurring slots in these groups.
week.definition: Traffic light by the slot demand rate in the window, with at least {sample} editions. Green: {green} or more (confirms without issues); if the most recent part of the window fell below {green}, it turns amber. Amber: between {floor} and {green} (variable: neither secured nor to remove). Red: {floor} or less. Secure field: lost to field unavailability in the last {days} days, with healthy demand or, with a small sample, at least two losses; it is a separate mark from the color. Trend is a difference of {delta} points or more between the first and second half of the window. Demand rate = confirmed / (confirmed + cancelled for lack of players). Each card context shows the last {last} editions.
week.limit: The database has no future games: the calendar says what is worth having, not what is still missing.
week.thin: {n, plural, one {# slot with fewer than {min} editions is not classified.} other {# slots with fewer than {min} editions are not classified.}}

suggest.NOT_ENOUGH_PLAYERS: Review pricing and promotion for the times with fewer sign-ups and concentrate supply on the slots that do confirm.
suggest.FACILITY_UNAVAILABLE: Confirm field availability with the facility before publishing and secure critical slots with an advance booking.
suggest.WEATHER: Define an alternative (covered field or another time) for bad-weather days and warn players in advance.
suggest.MAINTENANCE: Ask the facility for its maintenance calendar and do not publish those dates.
suggest.HOLIDAY: Check the holiday calendar and adjust supply for those days before publishing.
suggest.OTHER: Review the reasons recorded as Other case by case to see whether one cause repeats.
suggest.PLUGIN: Coordinate with the team that runs the plugin on why these games are cancelled.
suggest.UNSPECIFIED: Record the reason for each cancellation: without a reason there is no way to know what to fix.
suggest.supply: Talk to the facility about why fewer games are published and recover the times that stopped being offered.
suggest.generic: Review the facility slots one by one in its Forecast calendar.
suggest.up: Sustain these published times and secure the field in advance so they are not lost.

plan.methodProvisional: Provisional: with {n} months of history growth is not removed. It sharpens once there are 24 months.

plan.footnote: Reading: healthy demand = demand rate ≥ {demand}; elevated field unavailability = ≥ {unavail} of published, or rising versus the prior year. "vs prior year" compares the latest complete year with the one before, in percentage points (pp).
plan.planSubtitle: Per facility, looking at the same month in past years. Suggested lead time runs from 1 to 4 weeks depending on how much field time was lost and whether it is getting worse.
plan.planEmpty: No facility needs to be reserved ahead in these months.
plan.planFootnote: Only field loss that cancelled an already-published game is visible: a slot that could never be published leaves no trace. Depends on cancellation categorization.

PARTNER.hint: Delivers what was agreed and the relationship works. Worth investing: secure recurring slots and prioritize it in planning.

RELIABLE_DIFFICULT.name: Reliable but difficult
RELIABLE_DIFFICULT.hint: Holds up its commitments, but treatment or alignment is hard. Maintain: written agreements, a single contact, and don't give in on publishing.

OPPORTUNIST_CORDIAL.name: Cordial opportunist
OPPORTUNIST_CORDIAL.hint: Friendly, but uses us to fill its inventory. Publish only with firm confirmation and ask for blocked slots.

OPPORTUNIST_CONFLICT.name: Conflictive opportunist
OPPORTUNIST_CONFLICT.hint: Unreliable and a poor relationship. Minimum effort; look at nearby alternatives (weighing its share of market revenue).

NO_SIGNAL.name: Not enough signal
NO_SIGNAL.hint: There {count, plural, one {is # entry} other {are # entries}}, still too few or too old to classify. More recent entries will clear it up.

D1.name: Compliance
D1.hint: Does what was agreed hold? Withdrawn published slots, substitutions, cancellations requested by the facility.

D2.name: Offer quality
D2.hint: What do they give us? Late release, leftovers only, slots that never repeat, field complaints.

D3.name: Alignment
D3.hint: Do they respect our decisions? How requests end when we say no.

D4.name: Treatment & communication
D4.hint: Treatment, slow replies and positive gestures.

metrics.frictionHint: Negative events per 10 confirmed games, last 90 days. No value under 10 games.
metrics.attributableHint: % of the last 90 days' cancellations attributable to the facility: 'field unavailable' reason plus games linked to availability events, never counting the same game twice.
metrics.demandHint: Confirmed over confirmed plus demand-cancelled, last 90 days, against the market average. Read it together with behavior: causality runs both ways.
metrics.requestsHint: Insistence: how many requests the facility makes. Neutral on its own.
metrics.conflictHint: Conflict: % of the requests we turned down that ended in a hostile reaction or an imposed condition.

SUB_LOGGING.name: Possible under-logging
SUB_LOGGING.hint: The data shows 'field unavailable' cancellations and no availability event was logged in 90 days.

HOSTILE_REPEAT.name: Repeated hostile conduct
HOSTILE_REPEAT.hint: Two or more serious or hostile treatment facts in 90 days.

RETIRO_STREAK.name: Streak of withdrawals
RETIRO_STREAK.hint: Three or more slot withdrawals in the last 60 days.

PLEI_FAULTS.name: Our own failures
PLEI_FAULTS.hint: We logged two or more Plei failures in 90 days: read the status with that context.

table.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total}. Filter by market to see the rest.

state.footnote: A proposal, not a label: derived from the logged facts (recent ones and those confirmed by others weigh more) and from the last 90 days of games. Each dimension needs minimum evidence to score. Thresholds are a first calibration.
